artifact_scope: Post-V1 exploratory G1/G3/G5 evidence; not part of frozen V1 confirmatory study and not deployment efficacy

G1_topology_dependence_interaction.interpretation: At fixed 0.5 marginals, increasing joint closure probability has opposite effects in parallel-redundant and serial-cut return structures. The exact two-hazard interaction identity explains the sign reversal.

G3_safe_learning_lockout.strict_credible_gate_zero_exposure_condi: 40/45 across p x threshold x confidence grid
G3_safe_learning_lockout.note: The strict gate can remain permanently uninformative when no passive update is available and the prior conservative return bound rejects exposure.

G3_risk_budget_deadlock_breaker.interpretation: A finite exploration budget breaks cold-start non-identification, but additional information is purchased with exposure and observed failures. The mechanism is a trade-off comparator, not a safety solution.

G5_full_reachable_state_space.interpretation: The exact quotient removes very large reachable history redundancy even though the frozen early-goal A* benchmark realized only modest search-time reduction.

claim_gate_update.G1: STRENGTHENED: topology-dependent dependence sensitivity now has an exact two-hazard interaction characterization; still requires systematic literature review and realistic execution validation.
claim_gate_update.G3: TRADEOFF ESTABLISHED, METHOD NOT SOLVED: risk budget breaks lockout but incurs explicit failure/exposure cost; next work should study topology-specific identifiability and better information sources.
claim_gate_update.G5: STRENGTHENED AS COMPANION: full reachable-state compression is large, but primary online A* benefit remains workload-dependent.

limitations: single retained seed for the risk-budget grid
risk-budget charge is a posterior model quantity, not a physical safety certificate
G5 exhaustive state-space diagnostic is not a runtime guarantee
no ROS/Gazebo or physical-robot validation in this artifact
